_doc: Lexicon entries (plan area 2, items 680, 759). Key: entry id as stored in GameState.records["lexicon"]. Granted by bonus goals (battle_goals.json "lore") or by a Wayfarer's "lexicon" key after a win. matchups: [element, species] pairs a lore page teaches when it is written down (KAMPF_PLAN_1000 item 90); the factor comes from the type chart.

cartographers.title: The cartographers
cartographers.text: Kestra's guild draws every road of Veydal again each year. A map that is not walked goes wrong, they say, and a Wayfarer who keeps all their Spirlings standing walks it best.

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.text: An art can set off a status already on its target. Volt races through a Soaked foe, Gale blows it dry and slows it, Tide douses Scorch, Stone grounds a Jolt, Lumen startles a Drowsing foe awake, and Ember burns the roots off a Rooted foe but sets it alight. The battle log names every reaction it sees.

dual_elements.title: Two elements
dual_elements.text: A Spirling of two elements takes both factors at once: they multiply. Strong into both is x4, strong into one and resisted by the other is x1, resisted by both is x0.25. No hit ever does nothing.

rift_mystics.title: Rift mystics
rift_mystics.text: The mystics at the Tide Rift listen to the Hush instead of fighting it. They chain reactions on purpose, one status feeding the next art.

drowned_heart.title: The Drowned Heart
drowned_heart.text: The Hush gathered at the bottom of the Tide Rift into one heavy heart. It grows with every Spirling you field, so a full team does not crush it, it only meets it.

warden_orrin.title: Orrin's cover
warden_orrin.text: Orrin knows that Tide puts out his embers. That is why Shalebat walks with him: its Stone hide and Hunker Down take the Tide arts you answer with, while Kindlop and Smoldrake build up Energy.

warden_maelis.title: Maelis's cover
warden_maelis.text: Maelis knows her tide fears Volt and Bloom. Zephlet's Gale cuts Bloom down, and Zippit holds against the Volt Spirlings you bring, so her Riptail can wait for its moment.

bench_lessons.title: Bench lessons
bench_lessons.text: Spirlings in your team that stay on the bench still watch and learn: each healthy one gets half the growth of a fighter. Only the team learns, never the storage; a knocked-out Spirling learns nothing, and a ring cap holds for the bench too. Switch it in Settings.

growth_curve.title: Growth and rings
growth_curve.text: Growth fills a Spirling's ring; each ring needs more than the last, and there is no top ring. Wayfarers give half again as much growth as wild Spirlings. Story grows a quarter faster, rematches a fifth, a Growth Charm half again, and a Spirling that is very fond of you a little more. Before Era V, a higher ring than the foe costs nothing.

bond_stats.title: Echo calls
bond_stats.text: Every bond is an echo of the wild Spirling's call. A low Vigor, a status and a calming field help it along; a charm or an Echo Shell steadies the link. The odds are never shown, only the result.

field_rules.title: Rift fields
field_rules.text: A Rift field makes one element hit x1.2 and another x0.85. A Call art lays its field for 5 turns on every difficulty; then the place's own field comes back. A new field pushes the old one out at once.

field_ash_storm.title: Ash Storm
field_ash_storm.text: Ash hangs in the air. Ember arts hit harder, Tide arts sputter.

field_high_tide.title: High Tide
field_high_tide.text: The water stands knee-deep. Tide arts hit harder, Ember arts fizzle, and nothing can catch Scorch.

field_deep_murk.title: Deep Murk
field_deep_murk.text: Light drowns in the murk. Umbra arts hit harder, Lumen arts dim. At dusk and at night it holds a turn longer.

field_static_veil.title: Static Veil
field_static_veil.text: Every hair stands on end. Volt arts hit harder, Stone arts crumble, and Volt Spirlings gain 1 extra Energy each turn.

field_pollen_drift.title: Pollen Drift
field_pollen_drift.text: Pollen settles on everything. Bloom arts hit harder, Gale arts stall, and Bloom Spirlings mend a little each turn.

field_dawn_glow.title: Dawn Glow
field_dawn_glow.text: A pale morning light. Lumen arts hit harder, Umbra arts thin out, and an Echo call lands a little easier. At dawn and by day it holds a turn longer.

field_rubble_rain.title: Rubble Rain
field_rubble_rain.text: Grit patters down without end. Stone arts hit harder, Volt arts ground out, and nobody can be Jolted.

field_gale_eye.title: Gale Eye
field_gale_eye.text: A calm ring inside a circling wind. Gale arts hit harder, Bloom arts wilt, and nobody can be Drowsed.

field_rust_haze.title: Rust Haze
field_rust_haze.text: Red flakes hang in the damp air. Rust arts hit harder, Gilt arts tarnish. Whatever shines here does not shine for long.

field_ink_flood.title: Ink Flood
field_ink_flood.text: Ink seeps up and swallows every shape. Ink arts hit harder, Lumen arts drown. The clerks call it a clean page.

field_rime_fall.title: Rime Fall
field_rime_fall.text: Rime drifts down and settles on every edge. Frost arts hit harder, Ember arts gutter out. Nobody here remembers being warm.

field_gilt_glare.title: Gilt Glare
field_gilt_glare.text: Light bounces off gilded stone. Gilt arts hit harder, Rust arts flake away. Everything here is for sale, even the light.

boss_ashen_heart.title: What the Ashen Heart was
boss_ashen_heart.text: Before the Hush, the Cinder Rift fed a village's forges. The smiths sold the last of its heat to the highest bidder, and what was left curled up and learned to hate. It still keeps time like a bellows: hold it under High Tide and it can't stoke its next phase.

boss_drowned_heart.title: What the Drowned Heart was
boss_drowned_heart.text: The Tide Rift sank a ferry once, and the ferryman swore he had warned everyone. He had not. The heart at the bottom remembers every name on the passenger list. Static Veil sets its water humming, and while it hums the heart can't gather its next surge.

boss_mist_heart.title: What the Mist Heart was
boss_mist_heart.text: Mist hides things, and the people nearby paid it well to hide one thing in particular. When the payments stopped, it hid them too. Dawn Glow burns its fog thin; while the light lies, it can't pull itself into a new shape.

challenges.title: Challenge rules
challenges.text: Extra rules for a harder journey: One per Place, First Meeting, Spring Water Only, Shuffled Wilds and Arts, Stand Your Ground, Half Rested, Ace Up Front, Night Bonds, One Colour, Empty Pockets, Off the Books and Trust No One. Any of them combine. They are taken before the first mended Rift and can be dropped at any time; the record remembers. The shuffles follow a seed code you can share with friends.

ring_caps.title: Ring caps
ring_caps.text: On Veteran and Rift-Born your Spirlings grow only to the ring cap until the end of Act I: R12 at the start, then R15, R18, R23, R28, R32, R36, R40, R44, R50, R54, R57 and R60 as Rifts are mended. Rest springs name the cap of the moment. After Act I there is no cap.
